turns.speaker: agent
turns.transcript: Good morning! Am I speaking with Mr. Sharma? This is calling from ABC Finance regarding your personal loan account.
kb_snippets: Greeting script: Always confirm customer identity before discussing account details.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.transcript: Yes, this is Sharma speaking. What is this regarding?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.transcript: Thank you for confirming, Mr. Sharma. I'm calling about your personal loan with account number ending 4521. Our records show that your EMI payment of Rs. 15,000 was due on September 25th and is currently overdue. Could you help me understand if there's been any difficulty with the payment?
kb_snippets: Collection script: After identity confirmation, state the overdue amount and due date. Ask if there are any difficulties.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.transcript: Actually, I lost my job last month and I'm having trouble making payments right now. Can you give me some more time?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.transcript: I understand that must be a difficult situation, Mr. Sharma. I'm sorry to hear about your job loss. Let me check what options we have available for you. We do have a hardship program that might help. Would you be interested in exploring a revised payment plan?
kb_snippets: Hardship policy: Customers facing financial hardship may be eligible for EMI restructuring. Offer 3-month moratorium or reduced EMI for 6 months.
Empathy guidelines: Acknowledge the customer's situation before presenting solutions.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.transcript: Yes, that would be really helpful. What kind of options do you have?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.transcript: Sure, Mr. Sharma. Based on your account history, which has been excellent until now, I can offer you two options. First, a three-month moratorium where we pause your EMIs entirely. Second, we can reduce your EMI to Rs. 8,000 for the next six months by extending your loan tenure. Your interest rate of 11.5% would remain unchanged in both cases. Which option sounds better for your situation?
kb_snippets: Restructuring policy: Present both moratorium and reduced EMI options. Clearly state interest rate implications.
Compliance: Must disclose that interest accrues during moratorium period.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.transcript: Wait, you said Rs. 8,000 but I want to make sure. Is that the exact reduced amount?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.transcript: I apologize for the confusion. Let me double-check. The exact reduced EMI amount would be Rs. 8,500 per month for six months, with a four-month tenure extension. I should have been more precise earlier. Also, I want to make sure you're aware that during the moratorium option, interest would continue to accrue on the outstanding balance.
kb_snippets: Compliance: Must disclose that interest accrues during moratorium period.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.transcript: Okay, I think the reduced EMI option works better for me. Let's go with Rs. 8,500 for six months.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.transcript: Excellent choice, Mr. Sharma. I'm processing the reduced EMI plan now. Your new EMI of Rs. 8,500 will start from November 2026, and your loan tenure will be extended by four months. You will receive an SMS confirmation shortly. For the current overdue amount, could you make the payment of Rs. 15,000 by October 10th?
kb_snippets: After restructuring approval: Confirm new terms, request current overdue payment, set a deadline.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.transcript: Yes, I can manage that. Thank you for being understanding about my situation.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.transcript: You're welcome, Mr. Sharma. To summarize: your EMI is now Rs. 8,500 starting November, your confirmation number is RST-20261001-7743, and we'll expect the current overdue payment of Rs. 15,000 by October 10th. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
kb_snippets: Closing script: Summarize all agreed actions and provide confirmation details before ending.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.transcript: Thank you, Mr. Sharma. I wish you all the best and hope things improve soon. Have a great day!
